name: ViDia2Std
description: ViDia2Std is a manually annotated parallel corpus for Vietnamese dialect-to-standard translation covering all 63 provinces. It includes diverse dialects from Central, Southern, and non-standard Northern regions, making it the most dialectally inclusive corpus to date, designed to improve dialect normalization and downstream NLP tasks.
reputation: A newly introduced Vietnamese dialect normalization corpus that is likely to be used by researchers working on dialect-to-standard translation, but it is not yet broadly adopted.
notes: Dataset sourced from real-world Facebook comments; includes semantic mapping agreement metric for annotation consistency.
